sources.snippet: We apply SFT followed by GRPO to Qwen3.5-4B using LoRA [28] on the language backbone, with the visual encoder and multimodal aligner frozen. SFT trains for one epoch on 3,657 video QA examples with 32 sampled frames, ASR, and available interaction history. Targets contain the answer and one annotated observation; other rationale fields are null.
